scope.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs at the top of the grab candle after a sell-side grab, and for shorts at the bottom of the grab candle after a buy-side grab.
scope.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab and take profit at a recent swing level in the opposite direction: a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts.
scope.name: liquidity_grab_reversal

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: price breaks a support or resistance and does a fake out and heads in the opposite direction
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses in the opposite direction.
entry_sequence.rationale: A fakeout adds fuel to the reversal.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab
entry_sequence.action: For a long, enter at the candle that made the sell-side liquidity grab.
entry_sequence.rationale: The grab candle marks the reversal entry point.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: your short entry would be at the bottom of this candle that initiated this liquidity grab
entry_sequence.action: For a short, enter at the bottom of the candle that initiated the buy-side liquidity grab.
entry_sequence.rationale: The grab candle marks the reversal entry point.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we then move to a 1hour time frame and we see this Buy Signal signal happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame
entry_sequence.action: Use the 1H as the higher-timeframe context and prefer reversals occurring at higher-timeframe support or resistance.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker says the best trades happen at higher-timeframe tops or bottoms.

stop.transcript_quote: set your stop loss right right below the liquidity grab
stop.rationale: For longs, the stop goes just below the liquidity grab; the mirrored short case places it just above the grab.

targets.transcript_quote: set your take profit at a recent high
targets.rationale: For longs, the target is a recent high; the short side mirrors to a recent low.

confluences.transcript_quote: liquidity grabs with Peaks closer together
confluences.name: peaks_closer_together
confluences.description: Prefer liquidity grabs where the peaks are closer together, because the back test said those had a more impulsive drop.

confluences.name: divergence
confluences.description: Add divergences as a confluence to improve the setup.

confluences.transcript_quote: it performs the best if it's on the absolute top or bottom of the range
confluences.name: higher_timeframe_extreme
confluences.description: Only take the setup when the signal occurs at the absolute top or bottom of the higher-timeframe range.
